snippet.title: Echoes of Aincrad - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
The floating castle of Aincrad awaits. Watch the latest gameplay trailer and get your first real look at the fast-paced action RPG combat, deep character customisation, and breathtaking world of Sword Art Online: Echoes of Aincrad.

For the first time in the franchise, you are the hero. Design your avatar, forge your build, and fight for survival alongside your AI partner in a world where every battle could be your last.

Visit the official website for more information and to pre-order - https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/echoes-of-aincrad

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
